title: Keel Card
description: The contract card `graphhelm keel check --card` reads (#1330): the paths in scope, the promise and the command that proves it, plus the public symbols the change adds and an optional allowance. Every path the diff touches must equal a scope path or lie under one (keel.scope.path_outside_card). Bounds on the card itself are keel.yaml `card` (keel.card.*).

promise.description: The observable promise the change keeps.

scopePaths.description: Repository-relative files or directories, `/`-separated. Paths, not globs: `*`, `?`, `[` and `..` are refused (keel.card.scope_not_a_path).

proof.description: The command that proves the promise.

exportedSymbols.description: Public symbols the change adds. The check reports added public symbols the card does not name.

journeys.description: Journey contracts (`.graphhelm/journeys/<contractId>.json`) that prove the promise. keel check reports, without blocking, a screen the card's scope touches whose journey has no fresh capture at the head (keel.journey.no_fresh_capture).

allowance.description: Surface declared at planning time, added to keel.yaml `surface` and capped by `maxAllowance`.
